records.name: Tampa

salary_usd_year.note: levels.fyi has no dedicated metro page for this city (confirmed by direct URL testing); Glassdoor was attempted as the task's specified fallback but blocked automated access (Cloudflare). Bands instead derived from BLS OES May 2025 Software Developers (15-1252) wage percentiles for this metro: p10=$78,480 (new_grad proxy), median=$130,450 (mid proxy), p90=$207,330 (senior proxy). CAVEAT: BLS figures are base wage only (exclude stock/bonus) and are percentiles across ALL experience levels blended together (not discrete career-stage bands like levels.fyi uses), so these are not directly comparable to the total-comp bands used for the levels.fyi-covered cities in this dataset -- treat as a rougher estimate.
